result.description: A fictional 27-inch e-paper classroom tablet built for library kiosks, museum exhibits, and low-glare public reference stations. It uses a monochrome reflective display, passive stylus input, and a fanless ARM-based controller for quiet operation. Designed for annotation, reading, and guided browsing rather than gaming or high-performance media. Includes USB-C power, Wi-Fi 6, and a rugged anti-scratch front panel.
result.title: Aster Quill 27EP Classroom Tablet
